metadata.title: Koldil Bhaji |Banana Blossom stir Fry | Assamese recipe
metadata.description:
Koldil Bhaji is a staple side dish featuring in the meals of millions of Assamese in Assam and all around the world wherever the diaspora is. It is simple to make and not just nutritious but is medicinal. In this video I present a simple stir fry recipe with banana flowers that you can make easily. 

Ingredients

Banana flower - 1 
Potatoes - 2 mediums sized ones
Onion - 1 large one
Mustard Oil - 2 tbsp
Panchforan - 1 tsp
Green Chillies - 2-3 finely chopped
Garlic cloves - 4-5 finely chopped
Turmeric - 1 tsp
Salt to taste
